name: Personal note
description: A plain, signed note from a real person with one easy question to reply to.
subject: quick question, {{first_name|there}}

brief.send_when: A day or two after signup, from a founder or owner.
brief.mechanic: Looks like a personal email, so it gets read like one. Replies improve inbox placement and tell you what to build.

slots.label: Preview text
slots.help: Shown next to the subject in the inbox.

content.preheader: Not a newsletter. One question from the person who built this.
content.message: You signed up on Tuesday, and I read every reply to this email, so I'll keep it short.
content.question: What were you hoping it would do for you? Just hit reply; one line is plenty. I use the answers to decide what we build next, and I'll write back.
content.offer_help: And if you're stuck on something, tell me that instead. I'd rather fix it for you than send you a help article.
content.ps: Only have ten seconds? Reply with a number from 1 to 5 for how useful it's been so far.
